name: canvasight
description: A local canvas workspace for structured Codex prompts and generated image assets.

interface.shortDescription: Build prompt flows on a local canvas
interface.longDescription: Canvasight opens a native Codex widget canvas for arranging task nodes, managed assets, and flows. @Canvasight image requests can use Codex imagegen and add final images directly to the active Page as Asset Nodes. Runs return through the current Codex task's widget host bridge; browser fallback pages remain diagnostic.
defaultPrompt: Open Canvasight for the current Codex project workspace.
